'''Corwin''', also known as '''The Durasteel Duke''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as [[Duke/Legends|duke]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
Corwin was both a celebrity and local legend, a charismatic and fearless leader and politician who had never once backed down in the face of threats or intimidation or refused to meet a rival face-to-face. Around [[3643 BBY]], he was a target of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] and a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] found him, only to discover that Corwin was already dead and was impersonated by [[Muriel Corwin|his sister]] to bolster his house's morale.<ref name="TOR" />
